title: Unit rules
description: Combat numbers for units (CB-13..CB-15). All integers; times are in ticks. Names live in the presentation file.

health.description: At most 1000000000000 (MAX_HEALTH in the core); see "Content bounds" in docs/rules-reference.md.

moveCooldownTicks.description: Ticks to walk one cell. The speed is floor(240 / moveCooldownTicks) sub-cell units per tick.

radius.description: Radius of the unit's body in sub-cell units (240 per cell): used for reach, aggro, turret range and drawing.

collisionRadius.description: Radius of the circle that may not overlap another unit or blocked ground, in sub-cell units.

reach.description: Most the gap between the unit's circle and its target may be for it to attack, in sub-cell units.

flying.description: Reserved: false for every unit for now.

attackType.description: Reserved: melee is the only attack type for now.
